Rishi / Marissa —

I reviewed the attached architecture. Quick technical read: feasible, with a few caveats and an implementation checklist. High level items:

- KV cache invalidation: need strong guarantees around TTL/eviction and a rehydration path to avoid cache stampedes.
- Checkpointing: we'll need a compact snapshot format for prefix state to make async fallbacks consistent.
- Latency SLOs: recommend we surface an explicit SLO delta in the pilot contract (e.g., 99th p latency on cold hits <= +120ms).
- Security: ensure encryption-at-rest for vectors in S3 meeting our KMS policy and an access model that doesn't leak customer buckets.

I'll draft a short tech RFC this week; Sergio can weigh in on operational runbook items (runbooks, alerting, playbooks for rehydration).

Sergio — can you scope the on-call rotations and how Redwood will take ownership vs. Pinecone for incident triage?

Laura
Principal Integrations Engineer
